tldr: On the specified full \(C^{2,1}\) neighborhood, the minimax actual-welfare regret is \(n^{-3/4}\log(en)\) for every integer \(n\ge1\). A total original-record polynomial-projection and public equal-area ranking rule using order \(n^{3/4}\) deployment cells attains this rate and treats exactly one quarter of the population for every dataset. The quantitative transfer theorem shows that the same rate survives disclosure of each surface's entire aggregate benefit law. It credits the prior fixed-law orbit architecture: compact Hamiltonian shell alternatives satisfy both the prior bounds and the tighter full-class bounds, supplying a common hard fiber even after law disclosure. Independently, dense reflected alternatives certify cumulative saddle uncertainty at their actual common moving capacity cutoff. The result is a transfer and robustness extension to a new law-informed risk. This is a bespoke known-uniform-design, randomized-Bernoulli, exact-quarter, radius-\(10^{-5}\) saddle benchmark; it is neither a theorem on the published Bhattacharya--Dupas or method-ancestor classes nor an empirical claim about Western Kenya.
